_comment: cherrypick-technicals. Copy to ~/.cherrypick/config/technicals.json to override. 'dolt' is the LOCAL dolt sql-server that serves the stocks and options clones (the one the earnings module reads; kept alive by the earnings-dolt job and pulled at 05:30 by scripts/refresh_dolt_data.py).

skate._comment: The skate screen's range band (skate.py, docs/skate-plan.md): close +/- haircut x SMA(smoothing) of (highest high - lowest low over the sessions to expiry). 'haircut' is the fixed band's; 'by_expiry' is the second band's schedule, [[max calendar days, haircut], ...], first match wins, 'haircut' past the last. History counts from 'history_from' and over the last 'recent_years'; a name with fewer than 'min_history' past sessions is left out. The skate rate is recorded at strikes 0 to 'offset_max' past the band in steps of 'offset_step'.
